inspection_scope: Read-only candidate sources, non-sensitive Railway resource/config metadata, exact deployed GitHub source blobs, official TypeSafe web docs and pinned MIT agent skill. No credential values, inference, install, runtime changes, endpoint creation, deploy or key creation.

railway.auth: Existing service R3_API_TOKEN in Bearer header. Existing server-side TYPESAFE_API_KEY remains inside Railway.
railway.wire_response: Envelope {provider,state_sha256,questions_sha256,result}; actual TypeSafe answers/model are inside result.
railway.shortest_existing_probe: Set R3_TYPESAFE_URL to https://r3-typesafe-sister-production.up.railway.app/jev and invoke existing typesafe_sister/smoke.py on a token-bearing authorized executor. Payload is fixed backup fixture, so this alone would not answer skill selection.
railway.temporary_runner: Latest deployed commit message says temporary isolated Jev benchmark runner removed. Do not set old one-shot flags or redeploy to resurrect it.

shared_transport_reuse.direct_path: Existing typesafe_sister.client.system_one(state,questions,provider='typesafe',model='jev-latest') on an executor where TYPESAFE_API_KEY is already securely bound.
shared_transport_reuse.gateway_caveat: Changing only base_url to .../jev will not work: shared client appends /v1/systemone, gateway exposes /jev/judge and adds response envelope. Current client offers no path/envelope option.
shared_transport_reuse.existing_gateway_caller: typesafe_sister/smoke.py; older runtime r3/typesafe_smoke.py. For generic skill payload, adapt that caller or add a bounded explicit path/envelope mode to canonical client instead of introducing another semantic engine.
shared_transport_reuse.workflow: No existing live Jev dispatch/benchmark workflow with provider-secret binding was found in inspected candidate workflows; test_runner has local tests only.
shared_transport_reuse.vercel_alternative: Existing POST /api/orchestra calls shared assess_project_state but also other LLM providers/synthesis; application auth is X-Raffaello-Secret against RAFFAELLO_BRIDGE_SECRET, plus any platform protection. It is longer than existing Railway judge/direct shared call and does not accept arbitrary typed skill questions.

capability.official_statement: Jev does not generate text, chat, stream coding outputs or call tools. It judges provided state through typed answers. Function-calling cookbook maps fixed function names/arguments to typed questions and code invokes selected functions.
capability.web_search: No browse/search tool field exists in current official API contract or inspected shared/gateway code. No Jev web access/inference was executed in this inspection.
capability.skill_selection: Official skill-suggestion cookbook provides two-pass selection from supplied existing catalog: Choice probabilities shortlist, then fuller candidate descriptions/excerpts plus independent fit Nouls. Suggested skill remains advisory and may be rejected; loaded/available capabilities must be separately verified.
capability.threshold_boundary: Published examples use their own Jev1.12/Hermes data and cached results. Do not adopt thresholds or reported gains as R3 evidence.
capability.rank_boundary: Shared client rank is native CLM only; Jev skill ranking uses Choice probability distribution, not /rank.

official_skill.observed_guidance: Reuse code-owned workflow, retrieve candidate values/evidence, use typed judgments, live docs source of truth, no-match outcome, bundle independent questions, credentials server-side. No installation performed.

minimum_prerequisite: One securely bound existing credential on an executable host: TYPESAFE_API_KEY for canonical direct call, or the sister service R3_API_TOKEN for existing /jev/judge gateway. Read-only OAuth metadata access cannot substitute for this binding.
real_blocker: No credential-bearing executor or secure secret injection was established by this inspection; source and Railway variable-name presence do not create it.
next_action: Use the existing authorized credential channel selected by root to submit one bounded typed skill-catalog request through the canonical layer; record actual returned model, all requested answer keys, UTC time and payload/receipt hashes. Do not attribute Codex web research or catalog construction to Jev.
